steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each item is placed by its publish date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 item is past its publish date

findings.title: Item past its publish date not marked published
findings.fix: Publish it or move the date

findings.title: Item waiting for approval more than 3 working days

outcome.notChecked: Content quality, brand fit and claims (see `rlm-mkt-compliance-review`).

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks an item past its publish date that is not marked published; an item with no owner; an item waiting for approval more than 3 working days; a gap of more than 5 working days with no scheduled item for a.
cons: Not checked: Content quality, brand fit and claims (see `rlm-mkt-compliance-review`).
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-content-calendar skill on the records for this review.
